methodology: Current activity and public contacts were reviewed against direct official organization, agency, facility, or program pages. Personal contact information is included only when the organization publishes it for the relevant role.

Ashland Police Department Drone Program.current_activity: Ashland Police documents operational use of its drone, including infrared support during a missing-person response, and received a CY 2026 award to replace an aircraft already in service.
Ashland Police Department Drone Program.partnership_opportunities: Public-safety coordination and program questions can be directed to the Ashland Police Department.

CNU Autonomous Systems and Drone Lab.current_activity: Christopher Newport opened the two-story lab in 2026 and is using it for hands-on UAV instruction, programming, motion-capture-enabled testing, research, and industry engagement.
CNU Autonomous Systems and Drone Lab.partnership_opportunities: The lab is intended to support researchers and industry partners; program questions can be directed to Professor Abhishek Phadke.
CNU Autonomous Systems and Drone Lab.contact_text: Abhishek Phadke, Assistant Professor, School of Engineering and Computing

sources.title: Christopher Newport University faculty contact for the drone lab

Hampton University Uncrewed Aircraft Sys.current_activity: Hampton offers an active bachelor-level uncrewed-aircraft-systems curriculum with FAA-aligned remote-pilot preparation, autonomous-flight coursework, applied research, and industry and public-safety partnerships.
Hampton University Uncrewed Aircraft Sys.partnership_opportunities: Academic, workforce, and program inquiries can be directed to Hampton University's Department of Aviation.

Haymarket Police Department Drone Progra.current_activity: Haymarket Police documented a fully implemented department drone program and received a CY 2026 award to replace an aircraft already in service.
Haymarket Police Department Drone Progra.partnership_opportunities: Public-safety coordination and program questions can be directed to the Haymarket Police Department.

James City County Police Drone as First.current_activity: James City County Police began recurring DFR test flights in 2025 as a research site evaluating incident response and the feasibility of drone-delivered AEDs; the county states that AED delivery itself is not yet operational.
James City County Police Drone as First.partnership_opportunities: Public and research inquiries can be directed to the Police Department public information office.
James City County Police Drone as First.contact_text: James City County Police Public Information Office

Madison County Sheriff's Office UAS Prog.current_activity: Madison County appropriated its CY 2026 unmanned-aircraft replacement grant directly to the Sheriff's Office, confirming the operating agency.
Madison County Sheriff's Office UAS Prog.partnership_opportunities: Program and mutual-aid questions can be directed to the Madison County Sheriff's Office.

sources.title: Madison County Sheriff's Office contact information

MARS Unmanned Aircraft Systems Airfield.current_activity: The Virginia Spaceport Authority operates the dedicated MARS UAS Airfield for government and commercial training, testing, demonstrations, and exercises with access to restricted airspace at Wallops.
MARS Unmanned Aircraft Systems Airfield.partnership_opportunities: Government and commercial users can contact the Virginia Spaceport Authority regarding UAS airfield access and mission support.

sources.title: Virginia Spaceport Authority UAS Airfield facilities

NASA Langley CERTAIN.current_activity: NASA's current ROAM facility page identifies CERTAIN as Langley's designated live-flight range supporting small-UAS and human-autonomy research.
NASA Langley CERTAIN.partnership_opportunities: Research and facility inquiries should use NASA Langley's published contact routes.
NASA Langley CERTAIN.contact_text: NASA Langley Crew Systems and Aviation Operations Branch

sources.title: NASA Langley ROAM and CERTAIN operations

NASA Langley ROAM UAS Operations Center.current_activity: ROAM supports live, virtual, and constructive BVLOS research, air-ground integration, operator training, and human-autonomy experiments involving multiple vehicles.
NASA Langley ROAM UAS Operations Center.partnership_opportunities: Technical and research inquiries can be directed through NASA Langley's Crew Systems and Aviation Operations Branch.
NASA Langley ROAM UAS Operations Center.contact_text: NASA Langley Crew Systems and Aviation Operations Branch

NASA Langley UAS Test Range.current_activity: NASA's current ROAM facility page identifies Langley's designated UAS range as supporting live small-UAS operations connected to remote-operations and autonomy research.
NASA Langley UAS Test Range.partnership_opportunities: Research and facility inquiries should use NASA Langley's published contact routes.
NASA Langley UAS Test Range.contact_text: NASA Langley Crew Systems and Aviation Operations Branch

sources.title: NASA Langley ROAM and designated UAS range operations

Navy TALSA East Small UAS Training Facil.current_activity: TALSA East is the Navy's dedicated entry-level small-UAS training and logistics facility, supporting operator qualification, system storage, supply, and maintenance at JEB Little Creek-Fort Story.
Navy TALSA East Small UAS Training Facil.partnership_opportunities: Official inquiries can be directed through NAVAIR or the host installation's public contact channels.

Newport News Drones as First Responders.current_activity: Newport News is launching an incident-based DFR program integrating police, fire, and EMS response, with logged flights, defined policies, and a public activity dashboard.
Newport News Drones as First Responders.partnership_opportunities: Program questions can be directed to the Newport News Police Drone Unit.

Newport News Police and Fire Drone Unit.current_activity: The joint Police and Fire Drone Unit supports fire management, search and rescue, disaster and hazmat response, tactical deployments, major events, and scene documentation.
Newport News Police and Fire Drone Unit.partnership_opportunities: Mutual-aid and program questions can be directed to the Newport News Police Drone Unit.

Occoquan Police Department Public Safety.current_activity: Occoquan maintains a police-led public-safety drone capability and accepted a CY 2026 award to replace the existing aircraft with a compliant U.S.-manufactured system.
Occoquan Police Department Public Safety.partnership_opportunities: Public-safety and emergency-management questions can be directed to the Occoquan Police Department.

Radford City Police Department Drone Pro.current_activity: Radford Police is replacing its existing DJI Mavic 3T with a Skydio X10 and accessories through the CY 2026 DCJS program.
Radford City Police Department Drone Pro.partnership_opportunities: Program and public-safety coordination questions can be directed to Radford City Police.

sources.title: Radford City Police Department contact information

VIMS Autonomous Systems Laboratory.current_activity: The laboratory is developing autonomous underwater vehicles, persistent robotic swarms, bio-inspired autonomy, coordinated swarm software, and counter-misuse methods for unmanned systems.
VIMS Autonomous Systems Laboratory.partnership_opportunities: Research and collaboration inquiries can be directed to laboratory director Mark R. Patterson.
VIMS Autonomous Systems Laboratory.contact_text: Mark R. Patterson, Director, Autonomous Systems Laboratory

Virginia Spaceport Authority.current_activity: The authority operates the Mid-Atlantic Regional Spaceport and MARS UAS Airfield, providing launch, payload, integration, airfield, and mission-support capabilities from Wallops and Norfolk.
Virginia Spaceport Authority.partnership_opportunities: Commercial and government users can contact external relations regarding launch and UAS mission support.

Wise County Sheriff's Office Drone Progr.current_activity: Wise County's 2026 grant record identifies the Sheriff's Office as the grantee and states that the award will purchase a drone.
Wise County Sheriff's Office Drone Progr.partnership_opportunities: Program and mutual-aid questions can be directed to the Wise County Sheriff's Office.

sources.title: Wise County Sheriff's Office contact information

Wythe County Sheriff's Office Drone Prog.current_activity: Wythe County's January 2026 minutes identify the Sheriff's Office as the recipient of the CY 2026 unmanned-aircraft replacement award.
Wythe County Sheriff's Office Drone Prog.partnership_opportunities: Program and mutual-aid questions can be directed to the Wythe County Sheriff's Office.

sources.title: Wythe County Sheriff's Office contact information

York County ROVER Team.current_activity: The joint York County Fire and Life Safety and York-Poquoson Sheriff's Office team operates multiple aircraft for missing-person, hazmat, tactical, severe-weather, and other public-safety missions.
York County ROVER Team.partnership_opportunities: Public-safety and mutual-aid inquiries can be directed through York County Fire and Life Safety.
York County ROVER Team.contact_text: York County Fire and Life Safety
